subject: Big-data & Cloud Computing
text: A data warehouse is primarily optimized for…

subject: Big-data & Cloud Computing
text: Which tool is commonly used for distributed batch processing?
explanation: Hadoop supports distributed storage and processing.

subject: Big-data & Cloud Computing
text: In MapReduce, which phase groups intermediate values by key?
explanation: Shuffle/sort groups mapper outputs by key for reducers.

subject: Big-data & Cloud Computing
text: Which cloud property allows resources to scale with demand?
explanation: Elasticity adjusts resource capacity to workload.

subject: Big-data & Cloud Computing
text: Which model provides virtual machines and networking as services?
explanation: Infrastructure as a Service offers compute, storage and networking.

subject: Big-data & Cloud Computing

explanation: Clustering groups data by similarity without labels.

subject: Big-data & Cloud Computing
text: Which OLAP operation combines detail values into a higher-level summary?
explanation: Roll-up aggregates data to a coarser dimension level.

subject: Big-data & Cloud Computing
text: Which distributed processing engine is known for in-memory data processing?
explanation: Apache Spark supports distributed in-memory processing.

subject: Big-data & Cloud Computing

explanation: Map functions emit intermediate key-value pairs.

subject: Big-data & Cloud Computing
text: What does pay-as-you-go cloud billing charge customers for?
explanation: Pay-as-you-go billing is based on measured resource usage.

subject: Big-data & Cloud Computing
text: Which cloud model offers a managed platform for deploying applications without managing the underlying servers?
explanation: Platform as a Service provides managed runtime and deployment facilities.
